_doc: Synthetic Volatility 3 windows.pslist.PsList JSON output for an encrypted C2 baseline. Mirrors the real Volatility 3 schema (PID/PPID/ImageFileName/CreateTime/ExitTime). One process is the test client (PID 4580, name 'test-client.exe') with the matching TCP socket from the netscan fixture. Used by tests/unit/test_memory_parser.py. The fixture is committed so the parser tests do not require a real Volatility 3 binary or a real memory image.
